answer: Let every newcomer dock at a public jetty: their first jobs are inspected in the open by established peers before they can trade, so a fake identity has nowhere to hide. Make trust move like a glacier — slow, heavy, and impossible to rush — with rewards vesting over weeks instead of paying out at once. Then wind verification into a spiral: each payout unlocks a deeper check from a different set of verifiers, so a sybil farm must pass every turn of the spiral with fresh proof, and the cost of faking grows faster than the reward.
